2.16.23
Textbox.Paragraphs
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The Textbox.Paragraphs element specifies a collection of Paragraph elements within a Textbox. This
element is of type Paragraphs. This element MUST be specified.
Following is the parent element of the Textbox.Paragraphs element.
Parent elements
Textbox
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Textbox.Paragraphs element.
 <xsd:element name="Paragraphs" type="ParagraphsType" minOccurs="1" />
